value.rationale: The update keeps the common clause-role operation but replaces the former gate around parse_disposal with a compositional semantic reader. Separate learned judgments identify the operative actor, principal action and choice allocation, trigger, disposal information, retained information, exceptions or retention basis, and temporal qualification. The finisher constructs only common59 terms from those judgments. Unsupported deadlines, priority rules, certification duties, and linked backup or retention-expiry effects remain explicit unresolved items rather than being silently erased. Existing disclosure parsing is preserved, while the old lexical disposal parser is never called.
